Bash(git commit -m "feat: Add MANDATORY conda environment enforcement at agent top

CRITICAL FIX: AI was ignoring conda environment requirement

**Problem:**
AI executed bare ''python'' commands, causing:
- ModuleNotFoundError (missing PyTorch, CUDA, etc.)
- Using CPU instead of GPU
- Wrong Python version (system Python 3.13 instead of conda env)

**Solution:**
Added prominent MANDATORY RULE section at the very top of agent prompt:
- Multiple warning symbols (⚠️🚨) for visibility
- Clear WRONG vs CORRECT examples
- Explanation of why conda is required
- Mental checklist before executing Python commands

**Location:**
Placed immediately after agent title, BEFORE all other content,
ensuring AI sees this rule first every time.

**Examples Added:**
❌ WRONG:
  python script.py
  cd somewhere && python script.py
  nohup python script.py &

✅ CORRECT:
  conda run -n agentUse python script.py
  cd somewhere && conda run -n agentUse python script.py
  nohup conda run -n agentUse python script.py > log.txt 2>&1 &

This ensures AI will ALWAYS use conda environment for Python commands.
